title: The Oath on the Terrace
turn: A council runner climbs onto the terrace, reads Justin's name from the blood oath, and announces that the debt is due at dawn.

needs.text: Ruby and Justin co-own the tavern
Justin signed a blood oath to secure the loan

infos.text: Justin and Ruby co-own this tavern, and it was built on their shared gamble.
Candy holds the loan Justin took, and he has been paying her interest on it.
Justin signed a blood oath to secure that loan, binding his name to it.
Justin cannot remember the night he signed the oath.
The oath ties Justin to the council's cells beneath the city.

beats.what: Ruby tells Candy, in one line, that she and Justin opened this tavern together three years ago, when neither of them had a coin.
Candy counts her coins twice without looking up, while Justin tips a passing elf with the last silver he has.
Candy tells Justin, in one line, that the interest he has been paying her comes from a loan with his own name on it.
Ruby and Justin recall the night the first customer walked in, each with a different version of who lit the fire, while Candy listens.
Ruby tells Candy, in one line, that Justin once signed a blood oath to secure the loan, and she says it as if she was there to see it.
Justin tells Ruby straight out, aloud, that he wants the debt gone before anyone learns what he signed.
Candy tells Justin that if tonight passes without payment, the council will take the tavern and everything inside it.
Justin must decide how to cover the debt before dawn, and whether Ruby will know what he is hiding.
opts: Pay Candy with the tavern's savings

beats.what: Ruby publicly sides against using the tavern's savings, so Justin knows exactly whom he will disappoint.
A council runner is climbing the stairs with Justin's name on his list; Justin must decide whether to run or stay and face him.
opts: Run before the runner reaches the terrace

beats.what: Ruby tells Justin, in one line, that she watched him sign the oath, and that he was not himself that night.
The runner tells Justin, in one line, where the oath sends a debtor who cannot pay, naming the cells beneath the city.

links.label: Ruby's version of the opening night contradicts the oath, and comes back when she admits she was there for the signing.
The threat of losing the tavern forces the payment choice.
Ruby's refusal to pay leaves Justin alone when the runner arrives.
